recognize_zh: 腸胃道黏膜固有層被密集的小型淋巴球浸潤，細胞核小、深染、圓至稍不規則，異型性輕微，並散在嗜酸性球；鄰近腺體保留而無明顯的淋巴上皮破壞，這種「單調小淋巴球、低度異型」的表現符合 indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder，但需免疫染色與 TCR 克隆性確認。
features: Dense, monotonous lamina propria infiltrate of small lymphocytes
Small round to slightly irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei with minimal cytologic atypia and no prominent nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; rare mitoses and no necrosis evident
Scattered eosinophils and occasional plasma cells
Adjacent crypt epithelium with goblet cells preserved without obvious lymphoepithelial destruction
describe_en: Gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy at high power shows the lamina propria expanded by a dense, relatively monotonous infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Scattered eosinophils and plasma cells are admixed, and the adjacent crypts with goblet cells are preserved without evident lymphoepithelial lesions or epitheliotropism. Large atypical cells, necrosis, and brisk mitotic activity are not seen. The findings are compatible with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract in the appropriate immunophenotypic (usually CD4+ or CD8+, low Ki-67) and clonal TCR context.

ddx.vs: Cells are medium-sized with marked epitheliotropism, CD8+/CD56+, high Ki-67, and often form ulcerated mass lesions.
Composed of pleomorphic medium to large cells with necrosis and background celiac enteropathy.
B-cell infiltrate (CD20+) of centrocyte-like or monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and often plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Chronic inflammatory bowel disease or reactive infiltrate
ddx.vs: Polymorphous infiltrate with crypt distortion, cryptitis, and basal plasmacytosis, and polyclonal TCR/IG studies.
